text: {"features":[{"name":"Relevant engineering track record","description":"Extent of professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Barely clears the minimum, with roughly early-career experience and only limited evidence of owning production services through their lifecycle."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a modest early-career record with some launched services but relatively narrow scope or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a solid track record with multiple production services tested, maintained, and launched."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial experience across several production systems with clear operational responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys a notably strong production record with extensive multi-year experience and repeated end-to-end ownership of numerous live services."}]},{"name":"Go fluency","description":"Strength of the letter’s evidence that the applicant can design and build production systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing or as one language among many, with no clear sense of depth or ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States regular use of Go but gives little evidence beyond familiarity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a principal language for backend or service work in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Go ownership through design or operation of backend systems tied to the team’s problem space."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates deep Go-centered architecture experience, especially building critical backend infrastructure or guardrails for security automation."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"Strength of the letter’s evidence that the applicant can use Python effectively for production tooling, automation, or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or leaves Python ability too vague to assess."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indicates basic or occasional Python use without production responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for internal tooling, automation, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes broad production Python work across services, analysis, automation, or test systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates extensive, production-grade Python ownership, especially for agents, tooling platforms, or well-engineered systems others extend."}]},{"name":"Data structures fluency","description":"Evidence of applied strength with data structures and algorithms in solving real engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of data structures or algorithms strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims general comfort with algorithms but offers no concrete application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one concrete example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong applied algorithmic judgment through a specific, technically meaningful redesign or optimization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys standout algorithmic depth by linking sophisticated structure choice or algorithm design to a consequential systems problem and clear improvement."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"Evidence of hands-on experience building or operating AI features relevant to the role’s preferred qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of hands-on AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without describing shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience shipping model-backed or LLM-based functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work together with reliability, evaluation, or failure-mode management."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial hands-on AI engineering with a strong emphasis on making AI systems dependable in production and relevant to the role’s automation goals."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"Evidence of experience designing systems that use agents with explicit structure, constraints, or orchestration.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or agentic systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers vaguely to AI automation without explaining an agentic design."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions designing agentic systems or pipelines but gives limited architectural detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete agentic architecture, typically Python agents paired with Go services, guardrails, or bounded actions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates end-to-end ownership of agentic tooling with explicit autonomy, permissions, auditability, or constraint design suited to security workflows."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Evidence of actually performing security assessments rather than only expressing security interest.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no direct evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest but describes assessment ability only vaguely or indirectly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on experience with activities like threat modeling, review, or validating fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessment work across new or existing systems with concrete methods and remediation follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep assessment credibility by framing reviews from an attacker or builder perspective and demonstrating repeated, substantive assessment ownership."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation ownership","description":"Evidence of building tooling that automates vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention working on vulnerability reports or handling workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in reducing security toil but gives no owned example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions some automation of vulnerability handling or triage at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes building triage, routing, classification, or deduplication tooling that materially reduced manual workload."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of a high-leverage vulnerability automation pipeline with clear scope, mechanisms, and impact on expert capacity."}]},{"name":"Security credibility signals","description":"Strength of supplementary evidence that the applicant actively builds security skill beyond generic claims, such as certifications or attacker-oriented practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no supplementary security signal beyond general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Adds a lighter signal such as a basic certification or occasional participation without much demonstrated rigor."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a meaningful external signal, such as regular CTF practice or a foundational security certification framed as deliberate skill-building."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Brings a strong signal such as OSCP-level certification or sustained attacker-oriented practice that clearly strengthens credibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals or presents exceptional attacker-oriented achievement, such as high-level CTF results plus rigorous certification or equivalent practice."}]},{"name":"Security mindset","description":"Sophistication of the applicant’s stated philosophy toward security as disciplined engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only generic interest in security, with no deeper view of how security work should be approached."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses concern for security impact but frames it mostly at the level of broad slogans or general seriousness."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear secure-by-default or attacker-aware mindset in at least one part of the letter."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a thoughtful view of security as rigorous engineering, resilience, or developer enablement."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a mature, distinctive security philosophy that is reinforced throughout the letter by examples, values, and a strong sense of responsibility."}]},{"name":"Role insight","description":"Depth of understanding of the team’s actual problem of using software and automation to scale security work across the development lifecycle.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames the role in broad software or security terms without showing real understanding of the team’s specific mandate."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows partial awareness of the role’s security focus but speaks mostly in generic terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Understands the job as security automation or secure-by-default tooling, but only at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates the role clearly in terms of scaling security work, reducing manual triage, or helping developers through better tooling and defaults."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates nuanced insight into the team’s mission by connecting automation, developer enablement, variant analysis, central infrastructure, and the leverage of scaling scarce security expertise."}]},{"name":"Google-specific tailoring","description":"How clearly the letter is customized to Google and this specific team rather than sounding reusable for many employers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could be sent almost unchanged to any software or security employer."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names Google or the team but adds little employer-specific reasoning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes some tailored language about Google’s scale, culture, or security approach."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes a clear Google-specific case by linking the applicant’s interests to Google’s internal ecosystem, Core context, or engineering-driven security culture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels highly tailored to Google’s Information Security Engineering context, using employer-specific details to explain both fit and motivation."}]},{"name":"Evidence of impact","description":"Extent to which the letter shows what the applicant’s work changed, not just what they did.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists activities or tools with no indication of outcomes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies usefulness but leaves results largely unstated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes plausible positive effects such as making a queue easier to manage or improving performance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear impact on workload, speed, reliability, or team capacity, even if only lightly quantified."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes outcomes vivid and convincing through concrete, high-leverage effects such as hours returned, bottlenecks removed, or major manual effort eliminated."}]},{"name":"Specificity of evidence","description":"How concrete and technically grounded the supporting examples are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims and adjectives with almost no examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few examples but keeps them generic or thin on technical detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Offers at least one concrete example tied to a system, problem, or responsibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses several specific examples with enough technical detail to make the claims credible."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently backs claims with concrete, role-relevant examples that reveal real technical depth and ownership."}]},{"name":"Independent technical initiative","description":"Evidence of self-directed engineering outside core job duties, such as open-source maintenance or substantial personal projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of independent technical work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or casual tinkering with limited scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows steady initiative through a maintained utility, side build, or occasional upstream contribution."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial initiative through an ambitious personal system, repeated upstream contributions, or meaningful open-source responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-directed engineering, such as maintaining a widely used project or building complex systems independently with sustained ownership."}]},{"name":"Role-fit synthesis","description":"How persuasively the letter connects the applicant’s background to the role’s requirements in a coherent overall case.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a disconnected list of claims or qualifications with weak linkage to the job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a basic case for fit but leaves several key experiences disconnected from the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects major experiences to the role in a generally coherent way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a strong, well-integrated argument that the applicant has done closely related work and understands why it matters here."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers an especially cohesive and persuasive fit narrative in which the experiences, examples, and motivation reinforce each other throughout."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"Quality of spelling, grammar, and sentence-level polish.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or usage errors that noticeably distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has multiple visible errors or awkward constructions, but the meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows occasional errors or rough phrasing that do not seriously impede reading."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is largely clean and polished, with only minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and professionally polished throughout."}]}]}
